artifacts.summary: Round-closing summary: shared link resolver, read-side project_cid in sapience-retrieve.sh, URL-recording negative control, and the stated current design in per-repo-scoping.md, with write-side project_cid explicitly excluded by sf1-engine Ruling 7.
Phase 5 (final) completion handoff: all phases complete, no further implementation work remains.

completion_data.completion_summary: Closed task 677's round: all eight named Sapience suites and the five-path verify-touched.sh scoped tier passed with zero failures, the write-path invariant (sapience-remember.sh, postflight-sapience-notes.sh, sapience-publish.sh unmodified, no MCP write tool prescribed) was re-confirmed, and the round summary was written. All five plan phases are [COMPLETED].

sapience_notes.subject: Task 677 phase 5 (close the round) found zero regressions across the full Sapience suite roster
sapience_notes.value: Re-running all eight suites the plan named (test-sapience-capture.sh, test-sapience-remember.sh, test-postflight-sapience-notes.sh, test-sapience-publish.sh, test-sapience-vault-read.sh, test-sapience-project-bind.sh, test-sapience-context-scoping.sh, test-sapience-mcp-registration.sh) under CORE_TEST_SUBJECT_MODE=source-store after four phases of changes to a shared lib and a consumer script produced zero failures and the Case-30 nine-copy worktree-block byte-identity assertion stayed green, confirming the resolver's deliberate no-tenth-copy design held through to the end of the round.

sapience_notes.subject: A read-side project_cid feature can be fully built and verified with zero live exercise
sapience_notes.value: The entire task 677 round (shared resolver, sapience-retrieve.sh's project_cid parameter, the project_rejected benign-degrade, and the documented design) was implemented and verified purely against a curl stub, because the server-side REPO_LINK_FOR flag is deployed empty for this account and no .sapience/project.json binding exists in this repository. This confirms that the url-recording negative-control pattern (pin the pre-change request shape as an assertion, then re-run it unmodified after the change) is sufficient to prove byte-identical no-op behavior for an unlinked repo without needing a live linked account to validate against.

sapience_notes.subject: verify-touched.sh's OWED fallback covered a five-path mixed code+doc touch set at zero extra invocation cost
sapience_notes.value: Running verify-touched.sh at phase-5 close over a mix of a lib, a consumer script, a test harness, a domain doc, and an index JSON file (five touched paths spanning code and documentation) produced 16 directly-selected suites plus a 98-suite OWED fallback pass, 114/114 passing, with one single command and no manual suite curation across the heterogeneous path set.

sapience_notes.subject: Write-side project_cid exclusion held through four phases of write-adjacent documentation work with no accidental re-opening
sapience_notes.value: Despite Phase 4 adding substantial new prose discussing the sapience_remember MCP tool and the vendor mcp.py's unrelated project routing argument, a git diff of the three write scripts (sapience-remember.sh, postflight-sapience-notes.sh, sapience-publish.sh) against the pre-plan commit remained empty at round close, and the new prose's four MCP-write-tool mentions were all discussion-only per rules/sapience-write-path.md's sanctioned-site list -- the exclusion named in Decisions survived documentation work that discussed, at length, the very tools it excludes.
